verdict.rationale: Asaas's own docs list payment links as an available feature, so the core capability exists. The evidence presents it only within the API feature list. Nothing shows links being created from the dashboard without code or shared to start selling right away. missing for 10: documentation of dashboard-based no-code payment link creation, evidence of link sharing and an immediate go-live flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately

citations.quote: Features such as subscriptions, payment links, split, receivables anticipation, subaccounts, invoices, and Webhooks are also available.
